evidence_summary: Formal suite: 8/8 TF-IDF reps evaluated on frozen harness v3 (config b51701f5a9c11692, seed 42). 5 PASS adversarial gates (LangDom<0.85, Jurist>0.5), 3 FAIL. Exact k-NN on stratified subsample n=2000 (HNSW artifact fixed). Citation heritage: 1,020 positive pairs from 174 cited decisions (0.1% coverage). All 8 reps FAIL (best recall@10=0.052). v17b normalization: 85,819 labels normalized (214->164 areas). Citation signals: +4-10% purity gains across 3 benchmarks. Text signals: -30-34% zoom_fine degradation. Uniform improvement FALSE. Scale benchmarks: Temporal stability (1/8 PASS), Hierarchy coherence (all FAIL), Cluster coherence (1/8 PASS), Cross-language (citation PASS, text FAIL), Boilerplate resistance (all FAIL, -0.57 to -0.80). Two-mode tradeoff REPRODUCED at 174k. No leakage, benchmark gaming, weak baselines, or unsupported claims detected. Negative results honestly retained.
